name: deep-research
description: From a question to a cited report: a plan of sub-questions, three researchers reading sources in parallel, a report with numbered citations, a citation check against the pages actually read, a claim ledger (each cited sentence judged against its passage by a model of another family), a search for counter-evidence against its main conclusions, an independent fact-check and up to three revision rounds.

question.description: What to find out, with any scope (period, place, purpose).

audience.default: a well-informed reader who is not a specialist

length.description: Roughly how long the report should be

plan.title: Plan the research
plan.prompt:
Write the research plan to research/plan.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

research-1.title: Researcher 1

research-2.title: Researcher 2

research-3.title: Researcher 3

write.title: Write the report
write.prompt:
Write research/report.md answering the question from research/plan.md and the notes in research/notes-*.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>
Audience: {{input.audience}}. Length: {{input.length}}.

fix-citations.title: Fix citations
fix-citations.prompt:
The citation check failed on research/report.md. Fix each problem: cite only pages that were read (the sources tool lists them), copy quotes and figures exactly, put computed figures in their own sentence ending "(derived: ...)", or cut the claim.

{{feedback}}

fix-claims.title: Fix unsupported claims
fix-claims.prompt:
The claim ledger (research/claims.md) found claims in research/report.md that the pages they cite do not support, or contradict. For each one: cite a page you read that says it, narrow the sentence to exactly what its page says, or cut it. Report what the sources disagree on rather than picking one.

{{feedback}}

counter.title: Counter-evidence
counter.prompt:
Look for evidence against the main conclusions of research/report.md and write research/counter.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

fact-check.title: Independent fact-check
fact-check.prompt:
Fact-check research/report.md against the pages it cites and against the question. Write research/fact-check.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

revise.title: Revise

fix-citations-2.title: Fix citations
fix-citations-2.prompt:
The citation check failed on research/report.md. Fix each problem.

{{feedback}}

fact-check-2.title: Second fact-check
fact-check-2.prompt:
Re-check research/report.md after the revisions: confirm each earlier finding in research/fact-check.md is resolved and nothing new is wrong. Update research/fact-check.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

revise-2.title: Revise again

fix-citations-3.title: Fix citations
fix-citations-3.prompt:
The citation check failed on research/report.md. Fix each problem.

{{feedback}}

fact-check-3.title: Final fact-check
fact-check-3.prompt:
Final check of research/report.md: confirm each finding in research/fact-check.md is resolved and nothing new is wrong. Update research/fact-check.md.

<question>
{{input.question}}
</question>

fix-claims-final.title: Fix the claims left
fix-claims-final.prompt:
After the revisions, the claim ledger (research/claims.md) still finds claims in research/report.md that the pages they cite do not support, or contradict. For each one: cite a page you read that says it, narrow the sentence to exactly what its page says, or cut it. Run check_citations before you finish.

{{feedback}}

done-with-findings.title: Report ready, with open fact-check findings

failed.title: Citations could not be made to check out
